_comment: Consumed by :core:ocr:fetchPaddleNativeLibs. sha256 must match the file published at
<baseUrl>/<path>. Regenerate with build.sh --manifest-only if the release is republished.
This manifest describes ONLY the build-time native artifact: `release` is the native
artifact tag, and `files` holds its libpaddle_ocr.so / libonnxruntime.so / libomp.so per ABI.
It is a different version axis from the runtime *model* releases (ocr-manga-v4,
ocr-manga-v3, ocr-models-v3, ocr-models-v4 - see ModelRelease.kt): the .onnx models and the
dict are downloaded at runtime by paddle/ModelDownloader and are deliberately NOT listed here.
libc++_shared.so is deliberately NOT listed: AGP already packages the NDK copy for any
module built with -DANDROID_STL=c++_shared (:core:dictionary), and a second copy in
jniLibs fails the app merge with a duplicate-path error. Re-add the release's
libc++_shared.so entries only if no other module provides it.
